messages:
elaine: Quick thread for the "Mini RefKit Workshop" launch: need announcement post, webinar format, benchmark appendix, and routing for signups. Goal: drive forks of the tutorial repo + Slack cohort.

omar: I can draft the post. Headline idea: 'Mini RefKit Workshop: Build a live demo in 45 minutes'. Keep raw metrics in an appendix.

dex: I'll own the repo and the hands-on lab. Plan: 15m setup, 20m guided build, 10m tweak & Q&A. Keep the lab runnable in <1GB memory.

clare: I'll coordinate webinar ops + email drip. Recommend 3-email sequence: invite, reminder, post-event with tutorial links + code.

elaine: For benchmarks, prefer a short reproducible table: median latency, tokens/s, and cost estimate for 1k tokens. Omar can reference it in the post.

omar: Yep I'll link to a bench notebook in the repo and add a short explainer blurb comparing fp16 vs int8.

clare: Routing: signups create a lead in our CRM with tag=refkit-mini and post hot leads to #devrel-inbound-mini. Add checkbox "I want workshop followup".

devrel-bot: Created channel #devrel-inbound-mini and posted webhook URL.

dex: I'll add a small Dockerfile and a quantized model profile so folks can reproduce perf locally.

sam: Add a short OSS note in the post: MIT license for the tutorial repo and contribution guidelines.

elaine: Timeline: draft post & landing by Sep 16, repo + lab by Sep 23, bench notebook by Sep 25, webinar week Oct 1. Any blockers?

omar: No blockers. I'll share first draft later today. :thumbsup:
